candidate.raw_translation: Yi zane-zane na wata ma'auni na polar ta hanyar shigar da radius r a matsayin aiki na gefe θ. Zaɓi digiri ko radians, daidaita tsakanin gefe da adadin misali, sa'an nan kuma bincika layin da kuma sauke haɗin gwiwarsa.
